about: A hotel owner: permission, two discovery answers (one volunteers a pain point), interest, closing.

turns.customer: We run a hotel in Madurai, about forty rooms.
turns.reply: A forty-room hotel, that helps. How does your team handle things like follow-ups, billing or reports today?

turns.customer: Mostly manually, in Excel and on paper. The front desk spends hours on it.

captured.current_process: manually in Excel and on paper

pain_points.value: front desk spends hours on manual work

turns.reply: That is a lot of manual work for the front desk.

turns.customer: Yes, I think it could be useful.
